subject: Re: Mutual success roadmap — confirmation of champion, owners, and 6‑week timeline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@healthsync.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual success roadmap: proposed champion + 6‑week timeline

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our conversation I wanted to put a short, actionable kickoff note on the calendar so we can align stakeholders and lock the 6‑week evaluation runway. High level:

- Champion: HealthSync AI to confirm a single product champion for day‑to‑day coordination.
- Redwood owners: Ben (AE) + Tessa (Solutions), Monica (Customer Success) + infra/engineering liaison (we'll add if needed).
- Target: 6‑week eval with two milestone reviews (week 3: integration smoke test; week 6: quality & cost review).

I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that maps goals -> owner -> date. Please review and tell us if the timeline or owners need adjusting. My ask: can you confirm the champion and the two technical owners (integration + data/privacy) by Tue 6/30?

Proposed next steps:
1) A short 30m kickoff (intro + roles) next week — I've included Tessa and Monica on this thread to help scope the integration checklist.
2) We'll update the MAP after your confirmation and share an invite with milestones and the shared Drive link.

Attachments: HealthSync_MAP_draft_v1.pdf (MAP draft), Kickoff-agenda.ics (proposed 30m slot)

If the dates don't work, tell me a couple alternatives. Looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555‑0199

--
Redwood Inference — production‑ready LLM inference (hosted, dedicated, private)

Subject: Re: Mutual success roadmap: proposed champion + 6‑week timeline

Thanks Ben —

This looks good and aligns with our internal priorities. Quick answers:

- Champion: Rahul Mehra (Head of Product) will be the primary champion for the eval.
- Technical owners: Myself (data/privacy lead) and Priya Anand (integration lead, copied separately) — I'll loop Priya into the kickoff invite.
- Timeline: 6‑week runway is acceptable; we prefer the week‑3 milestone to include a sample inference load test and a short security checklist (SOC2 evidence is needed for procurement).

Can we do the kickoff on Wed 7/1 at 10:30am PT? That works for Rahul and me. Please share the invite and the final MAP after you incorporate the owners.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Aisha Kapoor
Director, Data & Privacy | HealthSync AI

Subject: Re: Mutual success roadmap: proposed champion + 6‑week timeline

Hi Aisha & Rahul —

Great — thanks for confirming Rahul as champion. I've updated the MAP draft to list owners and added the week‑3 load test + SOC2 checklist as a milestone. See attached PDF (HealthSync_MAP_draft_v1.pdf) with owner columns filled in.

Quick notes on coordination:
- Week 0 (kickoff): alignment on success metrics (latency targets, quality pass/fail, sample datasets), and access needed (S3 bucket, service account).
- Week 1–2: integration & baseline inference run (small sample), secure connectivity (VPC peering or private link depending on your infra).
- Week 3: smoke load test + security checklist review (we'll surface the SOC2 artifact and audit logs).
- Week 4–5: iterative prompt/temperature tuning, cost‑saving suggestions (batching, quantization where applicable).
- Week 6: final quality & cost review, decision checkpoint for pilot/POC expansion.

I created a provisional 30m kickoff on Wed 7/1 10:30–11:00 PT and attached the calendar file (Kickoff-agenda.ics). If that slot doesn't work I'll ask Ben to propose alternatives.

Action items (short):
1) Aisha/Rahul: confirm champion & tech owners (done) and grant a service account with read access to a small test dataset by Fri 7/3.
2) Redwood: finalize MAP and share Drive link + invite (Ben/Tessa).
3) Monica will run customer success onboarding and be the post‑eval continuity owner; she'll reach out to schedule the week‑3 load test window.

I'll also attach a short checklist for the SOC2 artifacts we typically surface — happy to walk through during kickoff.

Thanks — see you Wed.

Tessa Morgan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555‑0128

Attachments: HealthSync_MAP_draft_v1.pdf, Kickoff-agenda.ics

Hi Aisha/Rahul —

Thanks for the quick confirmation and for looping Priya in separately. I'll own the week‑3 load test coordination and post‑eval handoff. For the kickoff, I'll prepare a brief onboarding packet (access checklist, shared Drive folder, and sample test harness) and drop it into the Drive link Tessa mentions.

A couple small asks before the kickoff so we can keep the first meeting tight:
- Can you share a small sample dataset (anonymized) or a schema dump before Wed?
- Do you have an internal SLA or latency target you'd like us to aim for during the eval? (e.g., p95 < 300ms at 10 qps)

If you prefer I'll add a 15‑minute pre‑kickoff with your integration lead (Priya) to review connectivity details; otherwise we'll use the 30m slot to do both intro + next‑steps.

I'll send a calendar update with the shared Drive link once Tessa/Ben give the final version of the MAP a thumbs up.

Thanks — Monica
